Pari,

I put thirty reasons in a jar. They are all about you.

Every note has a photo of us with it. Open them slowly, one at a time, and stay as long as you like.

always yours, Daksh

That was thirty, Pari.

There are more than thirty. I just ran out of jar.

Every one of them is true on your best day and on the days you do not like yourself. That is the part I want you to keep.

I love you. Not for what you do, just for who you are.

Yours, always,
